q24.

- `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` — `useCreateMemo()` mutation hook calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo({ memo: memoToCreate })`
- `web/src/connect.ts` — defines `memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport)`, the Connect-RPC frontend client
- `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` — `rpc CreateMemo(CreateMemoRequest) returns (Memo)` definition (compiled into `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts` and `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`)
- `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` — `func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemo(ctx, request *v1pb.CreateMemoRequest)` gRPC/Connect handler, builds a `store.Memo` and calls `s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)`
- `store/memo.go` — `func (s *Store) CreateMemo(ctx, create *Memo)` validates the UID then delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo(ctx, create)`
- `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` — `func (d *DB) CreateMemo(ctx, create *store.Memo)` builds and executes `INSERT INTO memo (...) VALUES (...) RETURNING id, created_ts, updated_ts, row_status` (equivalent driver methods also exist in `store/db/postgres/memo.go` and `store/db/mysql/memo.go`)
